MRI Information
The Tern Neuromodulation System is MR Conditional. A person with the Tern Neuromodulation System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Tern Neuromodulation System
Device Configuration Therapy OFF
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5T and 3T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 40 T/m
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 200 T/m/s per axis
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
B1+rms ≤ 1.2 µT
Maximum Whole-Body SAR 0.1 W/kg
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
